shortDescription: Manage L3 interfaces on Extreme Networks SLX-OS network devices.

options.name: aggregate
options.description: List of L3 interfaces definitions. Each of the entry in aggregate list should define name of interface C(name) and a optional C(ipv4) or C(ipv6) address.

options.name: ipv4
options.description: IPv4 address to be set for the L3 interface mentioned in I(name) option. The address format is <ipv4 address>/<mask>, the mask is number in range 0-32 eg. 192.168.0.1/24

options.name: ipv6
options.description: IPv6 address to be set for the L3 interface mentioned in I(name) option. The address format is <ipv6 address>/<mask>, the mask is number in range 0-128 eg. fd5d:12c9:2201:1::1/64

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the L3 interface to be configured eg. Ethernet 0/2

options.name: state
options.description: State of the L3 interface configuration. It indicates if the configuration should be present or absent on remote device.
